title: MedicalData
description: Structured output produced by the OCR parser for a Romanian Fișă de Aptitudine document. v1 of this schema covers occupational-medicine aptitude forms; future versions, discriminated by document_type, may add other document classes.

document_type.description: Discriminator for the document class this payload describes. Single-valued in v1; extend the enum when adding new document classes.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema this payload was produced against.

overall_confidence.description: Minimum of all populated entries in field_confidences. 0 means nothing was extracted.

needs_review.description: True when overall_confidence is positive yet below the configured review threshold.

field_confidences.description: Per-field confidence, keyed by the snake_case field name. Only fields the parser populated with a positive confidence appear here.
